name: Koyama Takeda
source:
One of the four directors of the police department. Has great influence in the police, access to any information. Almost lost a war with another corrupt director, but thanks to [url=https://vndb.org/c104176]Izuku[/url]'s help, he was saved. Has a young [url=https://vndb.org/c104206]daughter[/url], wife died a long time ago.
